name.title: Platform log name
name.description: Retained platform log label. This value is preserved when saving settings.

name.title: Controller log label (optional)
name.description: Defaults to Controller 1, Controller 2, etc. This label does not rename Home accessories.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: The wall-mounted controller's IP address. A reserved address in your router is recommended.

port.title: Port
port.description: Controller API port: normally 2025; Fujitsu anywAIR systems use 10211. This is not the Homebridge child-bridge port.

debug.title: Detailed debug logging
debug.description: Include sanitised request timing, read summaries and command confirmations for this controller. No Homebridge Debug Mode required.

homeName.title: Name
homeName.description: Home accessory base name, e.g. Aircon or Downstairs Aircon. Additional aircons use Name 2, Name 3, etc. Use a distinct base for each controller. Zone names come from the controller.

debug.title: Detailed debug logging for all controllers
debug.description: Enable detailed diagnostics for every controller. Individual selections are preserved when this is turned off. No Homebridge Debug Mode required.
